description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of experts and a normalized gate average value for different model types. The x-axis is labeled “Experts” and has a linear scale ranging from 1 to 64, with tick labels at intervals of 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis is labeled “Normalized Gate Average” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.20, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The “Intent” line is colored red and begins at approximately 0.18 when Experts = 1, decreasing to approximately 0.02 when Experts = 64. The “Summary” line is colored orange and begins at approximately 0.16 when Experts = 1, decreasing to approximately 0.02 when Experts = 64. The “Translation” line is colored green and begins at approximately 0.12 when Experts = 1, decreasing to approximately 0.01 when Experts = 64. The “Law” line is colored light brown and begins at approximately 0.09 when Experts = 1, decreasing to approximately 0.01 when Experts = 64. The “Math” line is colored purple and begins at approximately 0.08 when Experts = 1, decreasing to approximately 0.01 when Experts = 64. The “Code” line is colored gray and begins at approximately 0.07 when Experts = 1, decreasing to approximately 0.01 when Experts = 64. A dashed black line is present at a y-value of 0.00, extending across the entire x-axis.
